ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 95:5 low-intensity (black/dark gray) to high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous block of low-intensity black pigmentation covering >90% of the surface area. High-intensity pixels are localized primarily in small clusters at the distal tips and a few scattered micro-spots near the central lower region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex angle estimated at approximately 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant pixel amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) are most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature extending from the median notch toward the distal tips; leading edges exhibit a slight convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, heterogeneous pixel clusters (white/beige) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct, faint linear pixel disruption visible as a light diagonal scratch on the right lobe (viewer perspective), extending from the mid-lobe toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral calcified clusters (barnacles) present on the distal edges of both fluke lobes.
